summary: Backend-only regression + health endpoint verification for ASM Nöbet Çizelgesi. Both /health (app-level) and /api/health return 200 with {status:'ok', service:'asm-nobet-cizelgesi'}. Ran full pytest suite (22/22 tests passed) covering health, auth PIN flow, physicians CRUD, template GET/PUT, assignments GET/PUT/bulk, holidays GET/PUT, and cascade delete. IMPORTANT DEPLOYMENT NOTE: on the preview environment, the public ingress routes only /api/* to the backend pod; non-/api paths (including /health) are routed to the Expo frontend and return HTML. The app-level /health is therefore only reachable directly on the backend container port (8001), which is how a Kubernetes liveness/readiness probe would hit it. If the deployment agent is probing /health via the public ingress rather than the pod port, /health will still 404 in prod — the deployment probe should target the backend container port or use /api/health.

minor.issue: Reachable directly on backend :8001 (returns 200 JSON) but NOT via the public preview ingress, which routes non-/api paths to the Expo frontend and serves HTML with 200. Verify the deployment liveness/readiness probe hits the pod's backend container port (not through ingress), otherwise use /api/health as the probe path.

action_items: Confirm with the deployment agent that the k8s liveness/readiness probe targets the backend container port (8001) directly, or switch the probe path to /api/health so it flows through the ingress. The app-level /health works locally but ingress rewrites non-/api traffic to the frontend.
No code changes required in server.py — both health endpoints are correctly implemented and returning 200 JSON.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is compact (~270 lines) and clean; models use uuid ids, _id is excluded from all reads, async motor calls throughout, env vars used for MONGO_URL/DB_NAME.
CORS middleware is added after include_router — order is fine in FastAPI, but conventionally middleware is registered before routers.
Uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown') hook; consider migrating to the lifespan context manager (non-blocking).

rca_of_issue: Health endpoints are correctly implemented in FastAPI (server.py L239-241 for /api/health via APIRouter, L247-249 for app-level /health). Verified via localhost:8001 and public /api/health — both return 200 JSON. The original 404 for /health seen by the deployment agent is due to Kubernetes ingress rewriting non-/api requests to the Expo frontend on port 3000 (which historically had no /health route and returned 404). Mitigation: point the deployment probe at the backend container port directly, or use /api/health as the probe URL.
